title: Amrize Expands ‘Made in Canada’ Cement Label
body_markdown:
- ‘Made in Canada’ label provides guarantee of Canadian manufacturing, quality and jobs
- Label offered at Amrize plants in British Columbia, Alberta, Ontario and Nova Scotia
- Amrize’s plant in Quebec will carry a ‘Manufactured in Québec’ designation
- Amrize investing to expand local production to meet growing construction demand


**TORONTO, November 4, 2026 –** Amrize (NYSE: AMRZ) is launching its ‘Made in Canada’ label across its domestic cement manufacturing network, offering builders the assurance of Canadian-made manufacturing and quality, supporting local jobs and communities.


As Canada’s largest cement manufacturer with a highly efficient distribution and logistics network, Amrize is rolling out the ‘Made in Canada’ label across its plants from Richmond, British Columbia and Exshaw, Alberta to Bath, Ontario and Brookfield, Nova Scotia. Following the[Competition Bureau of Canada guidelines](https://competition-bureau.canada.ca/en/deceptive-marketing-practices/made-canada-claims) , the label confirms the Amrize cement is manufactured in Canada with over 90% Canadian content inside. Amrize’s Saint-Constant plant in the Montreal area will carry the official ‘Manufactured in Québec’ designation administered by Les Produits du Québec.


“We are proud to be Canada’s largest cement manufacturer and this label reflects our commitment to serving Canada’s builders as a true local partner, offering Canadian-made quality, supporting local jobs and communities,” said Cory Cannon, Senior Vice President, Canada Cement Commercial, Amrize. “As Canada invests in its future from critical infrastructure, energy and industry to transportation and housing, locally produced materials are more essential than ever. Our label offers customers a single, consistent standard for high performance and reliability, backed by Amrize’s national scale and local service.”


Amrize’s ‘Made in Canada’ label comes as the Government of Canada commits $51 billion over the next decade through its[Building Communities Strong Fund](https://housing-infrastructure.canada.ca/bcsf-fbcf/index-eng.html) to support public infrastructure, including transit, healthcare facilities, and essential services for new housing. As Canada invests in its future, Amrize is investing to expand production capacity and modernize cement operations. Most recently, the[company broke ground](https://www.amrize.com/us/en/media/newsroom/amrize-to-modernize-montreal-area-cement-plant-to-be-most-advanc) on the modernization of its cement plant outside Montreal, the largest investment in the Canadian cement industry over the last decade.


[With a legacy of building Canada for over 100 years](https://www.amrize.com/us/en/our-company/we-build-canada) , Amrize has helped shape many of the country’s most recognizable landmarks – from iconic sites like the Rogers Centre in Toronto, the Confederation Bridge linking Prince Edward Island to New Brunswick, the Samuel de Champlain Bridge in Montreal, and essential infrastructure including major hub airports in Vancouver[(YVR)](https://www.amrize.com/us/en/media/stories-insights/working-overnights-how-yvr-got-a-new-runway) , Calgary[(YYC)](https://www.amrize.com/us/en/media/stories-insights/ready-for-takeoff--a-new-runway-for-calgary--no-flights-delayed) and Montréal (YUL).


In Canada, Amrize operates from 450 sites with more than 7,500 teammates serving customers in every province. Learn more about Amrize in Canada,[here](https://www.amrize.com/us/en/our-company/we-build-canada) .


### About Amrize


Amrize (NYSE: AMRZ) is building North America, as the partner of choice for professional builders with advanced branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. With over 1,000 sites and a highly efficient distribution network, we deliver for our customers in every U.S. state and Canadian province. Our 19,000 teammates uniquely serve every construction market from infrastructure, commercial and residential to new build, repair and refurbishment. Amrize achieved $11.8 billion in revenue in 2025 and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange. We are ready to build your ambition.
